result:
These queries are untested, since I couldn't run anything. A few verbs are guesses from the page: `round 2` for decimals, `sub /a /b` taking two operands the way `mul /price /qty` does, and `indexBy` taking a key quote. For N10 and N14 there is no `trim`, so I split on spaces and take the first non-empty piece.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(at :active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) | * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * {:name /customer/name :g (/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) :d (at :discount | coalesce 0)} | * {:name /name :amt (sub /g /d)} | groupBy ~(/name | keyword) * (* /amt | sum) | :m / | keys * (:k / | {:customer (k | keyword) :total (m | at k | round 2)}) | sort ~(/total) | reverse | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (type | eq ::map) ~(/login) ~("unassigned") | keyword) * count
N4: [(at :dependencies | coalesce {}) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {})] | reduce {} ~(union) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * keyword | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | {:enabledCount count :ports (vals * (at :port) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (vals * (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2 | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1)) | groupBy * count | :m / | keys * (:k / | {:service (k | keyword) :count (m | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(count | eq 4) | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | filter ~(/3 | count | gt 0) | * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/r | keyword) * (* /v | sum | round 2)
N8: :e / | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") | * /user | distinct | minus (e | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") | * /user | distinct) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/dept | keyword) * (div (* /salary | sum) count | round 1)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ":" | last | split "," | * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | first | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "apple" "date"] | * lower | groupBy * count | filter ~(gt 1) | :m / | keys * (:k / | {:word (k | keyword) :count (m | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) | * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets * (/download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~(/downloads) | reverse | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | {:count count :allPriced (every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (filter ~(/stock | gt 0) | * /name | sort)}
N14: lines | * (split "#" | first | split " " | first) | filter ~(contains "==") | indexBy ~(split "==" | first | lower | keyword) * (split "==" | /1)
